lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: While taking on a mission,

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: a thought struck me:

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: If I had not become a maid,

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: what work might I have taken up?

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: I mulled over it for some time,

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: yet the answer eluded me...
I can't really imagine you as anything but a maid.

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: So, Master, you feel the same.

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: Were I to pursue another profession,

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: what kind of role do you believe would suit me best?
A cool special agent.
A seductive bunny girl.

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: In the course of carrying out this mission,

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: I found myself taking an interest in the work of a secret agent.

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: At times, I even deemed it rather enjoyable.

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: And yet...

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: Oh...

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: I suppose...

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: I rather doubt that a bunny girl...

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: would be fitting for me...
It looks really good on you.

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: I see...

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: Even so...

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: I feel that any appearance other than that of a maid

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: would feel unnatural to me.

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: Even during missions, no matter what disguise I take,

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: I always strive to uphold my duties as a maid

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: by doing my utmost to serve you, Master.

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: I believe it is precisely because I hold to that principle that I'm able to take on other appearances at all.

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: After all, it's all in pursuit of becoming the perfect maid.
As expected of a perfect maid!

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: Thank you kindly. :)
So does that mean I'll get to see you in all sorts of costumes from now on?

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: Pardon me, Master,

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: but I'm not sure I fully understand.
You said that being a maid lets you take on all kinds of appearances, right?

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: Yes, that is so.
All kinds of appearances... right?

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: Oh!
I'm looking forward to what kind of outfit comes after the bunny secret agent.

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: Oh, no...

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: That's not what I meant!

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: I didn't mean I'll be wearing all sorts of costumes from now on...

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: Of course, a maid outfit is technically a costume too,

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: but that's not the point.

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: What I was trying to say is...

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: Um, Master?

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: You're still reading this, aren't you? T_T
I want to tease Ade a little more, so I'll just leave things as they are.
